name: Circle reveal
summary: Frame covered in colour with a circular hole that grows to reveal the scene, or shrinks to close it.

params.name: mode
params.note: out grows the hole to reveal, in shrinks it to cover

params.name: x
params.note: centre of the hole, x in px (0..1080)

params.name: y
params.note: centre of the hole, y in px (0..1920)

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
